author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
For the upcoming film Project Hail Mary, costume designers David Cross and Glyn Dillon were charged with creating a spacesuit that would have the hallmarks of a near-future NASA EVA suit and also stand out in the pantheon of movie spacesuits. Adam Savage went on set during the film’s production to get a firsthand look at this beautiful spacesuit and learn its design secrets!

Find tickets to Project Hail Mary: https://www.amazon.com/salp/projecthailmary
Project Hail Mary novel https://amzn.to/4cuCXJK
Thanks to Amazon MGM Studios for inviting us behind the scenes of Project Hail Mary, in theaters March 20th!
